title: A Pharmacy Visit for Chronic Fatigue

sentences.text_target: Mark woke up feeling a profound sense of exhaustion despite sleeping eight hours.
sentences.phonetic: /mɑːk wəʊk ʌp ˈfiːlɪŋ ə prəˈfaʊnd sɛns ɒv ɪɡˈzɔːstʃən dɪˈspaɪt ˈsliːpɪŋ eɪt ˈaʊəz/
sentences.text_native: Mark s'est réveillé en ressentant une profonde fatigue malgré huit heures de sommeil.

sentences.text_target: His demanding work schedule had been draining his physical and mental energy for weeks.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz dɪˈmɑːndɪŋ wɜːk ˈʃɛdjuːl hæd biːn ˈdreɪnɪŋ hɪz ˈfɪzɪkl ænd ˈmɛntl ˈɛnəʤi fɔː wiːks/
sentences.text_native: Son emploi du temps professionnel exigeant vidait son énergie physique et mentale depuis des semaines.

sentences.text_target: Realizing he needed professional guidance, he decided to visit his local pharmacy during his lunch break.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈrɪəlaɪzɪŋ hiː ˈniːdɪd prəˈfɛʃənl ˈɡaɪdəns, hiː dɪˈsaɪdɪd tuː ˈvɪzɪt hɪz ˈləʊkl ˈfɑːməsi ˈdjʊərɪŋ hɪz lʌntʃ breɪk/
sentences.text_native: Réalisant qu'il avait besoin de conseils professionnels, il a décidé d'aller dans sa pharmacie de quartier pendant sa pause déjeuner.

sentences.text_target: The morning street was bustling with commuters rushing toward the underground station.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈmɔːnɪŋ striːt wɒz ˈbʌslɪŋ wɪð kəˈmjuːtəz ˈrʌʃɪŋ təˈwɔːd ði ˈʌndəɡraʊnd ˈsteɪʃən/
sentences.text_native: La rue matinale était animée par des navetteurs se précipitant vers la station de métro.

sentences.text_target: He walked briskly around the corner and reached the familiar green cross glowing brightly.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː wɔːkt ˈbrɪskli əˈraʊnd ðə ˈkɔːnər ænd riːtʃt ðə fəˈmɪliə ɡriːn krɒs ˈɡləʊɪŋ ˈbraɪtli/
sentences.text_native: Il a marché d'un pas vif en tournant le coin de la rue et a atteint la croix verte familière qui brillait intensément.

sentences.text_target: Pushing the glass door open, he stepped inside and joined a short queue near the entrance.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈpʊʃɪŋ ðə ɡlɑːs dɔːr ˈəʊpən, hiː stɛpt ɪnˈsaɪd ænd dʒɔɪnd ə ʃɔːt kjuː nɪər ði ˈɛntrəns/
sentences.text_native: Poussant la porte vitrée, il est entré et s'est joint à une courte file d'attente près de l'entrée.

sentences.text_target: While waiting for his turn, he observed the shelves stocked with various wellness products.
sentences.phonetic: /waɪl ˈweɪtɪŋ fɔː hɪz tɜːn, hiː əbˈzɜːvd ðə ʃɛlvz stɒkt wɪð ˈveəriəs ˈwɛlnɪs ˈprɒdʌkts/
sentences.text_native: En attendant son tour, il a observé les étagères garnies de divers produits de bien-être.

sentences.text_target: When the assistant called him, Mark stepped forward to the main counter.
sentences.phonetic: /wɛn ði əˈsɪstənt kɔːld hɪm, mɑːk stɛpt ˈfɔːwəd tuː ðə meɪn ˈkaʊntə/
sentences.text_native: Lorsque l'assistant l'a appelé, Mark s'est avancé vers le comptoir principal.

sentences.text_target: He explained that his persistent fatigue was interfering with his daily responsibilities.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ɪksˈpleɪnd ðæt hɪz pəˈsɪstənt fəˈtiːɡ wɒz ˌɪntəˈfɪərɪŋ wɪð hɪz ˈdeɪli rɪˌspɒnsəˈbɪlɪtiz/
sentences.text_native: Il a expliqué que sa fatigue persistante nuisait à ses responsabilités quotidiennes.

sentences.text_target: The qualified pharmacist listened carefully and asked about his recent lifestyle habits.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈkwɒlɪfaɪd ˈfɑːməsɪst ˈlɪsn̩d ˈkɛəfʊli ænd ɑːskt əˈbaʊt hɪz ˈriːsnt ˈlaɪfstaɪl ˈhæbɪts/
sentences.text_native: Le pharmacien diplômé a écouté attentivement et a posé des questions sur ses habitudes de vie récentes.

sentences.text_target: Mark admitted that his diet had become irregular and his hydration was quite poor.
sentences.phonetic: /mɑːk ədˈmɪtɪd ðæt hɪz ˈdaɪt hæd bɪˈkʌm ɪˈrɛɡjʊlər ænd hɪz haɪˈdreɪʃən wɒz kwaɪt pʊə/
sentences.text_native: Mark a admis que son alimentation était devenue irrégulière et son hydratation plutôt mauvaise.

sentences.text_target: The pharmacist suggested that a mild vitamin deficiency could explain these symptoms.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈfɑːməsɪst səˈʤɛstɪd ðæt ə maɪld ˈvɪtəmɪn dɪˈfɪʃənsi kʊd ɪksˈpleɪn ðiːz ˈsɪmptəmz/
sentences.text_native: Le pharmacien a suggéré qu'une légère carence en vitamines pouvait expliquer ces symptômes.

sentences.text_target: However, she recommended consulting a general practitioner if the problem continued.
sentences.phonetic: /haʊˈɛvə, ʃiː ˌrɛkəˈmɛndɪd kənˈsʌltɪŋ ə ˈʤɛnərəl prækˈtɪʃənə ɪf ðə ˈprɒbləm kənˈtɪnjuːd/
sentences.text_native: Cependant, elle a recommandé de consulter un médecin généraliste si le problème persistait.

sentences.text_target: To help him regain his energy boost, she presented a specific box of magnesium tablets.
sentences.phonetic: /tuː hɛlp hɪm rɪˈɡeɪn hɪz ˈɛnəʤi buːst, ʃiː prɪˈzɛntɪd ə spɪˈsɪfɪk bɒks ɒv mæɡˈniːziəm ˈtæblɪts/
sentences.text_native: Pour l'aider à retrouver un regain d'énergie, elle lui a présenté une boîte spécifique de comprimés de magnésium.

sentences.text_target: She pointed out the dosage instructions printed clearly on the back of the packaging.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃiː ˈpɔɪntɪd aʊt ðə ˈdəʊsɪʤ ɪnˈstrʌkʃənz ˈprɪntɪd ˈklɪəli ɒn ðə bæk ɒv ðə ˈpækɪdʒɪŋ/
sentences.text_native: Elle a attiré son attention sur la posologie clairement imprimée au dos de l'emballage.

sentences.text_target: Mark read the information leaflet inside the box to check for any side effects.
sentences.phonetic: /mɑːk riːd ði ˌɪnfəˈmeɪʃən ˈliːflɪt ɪnˈsaɪd ðə bɒks tuː tʃɛk fɔːr ˈɛni saɪd ɪˈfɛkts/
sentences.text_native: Mark a lu la notice d'information à l'intérieur de la boîte pour vérifier d'éventuels effets secondaires.

sentences.text_target: The professional explained that these supplements might make him slightly sleepy at first.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə prəˈfɛʃənl ɪksˈpleɪnd ðæt ðiːz ˈsʌplɪmɛnts maɪt meɪk hɪm ˈslaɪtli ˈsliːpi æt fɜːst/
sentences.text_native: Le professionnel a expliqué que ces compléments pourraient le rendre légèrement somnolent au début.

sentences.text_target: Reassured by the helpful advice, Mark decided to purchase the product immediately.
sentences.phonetic: /ˌriːəˈʃʊəd baɪ ðə ˈhɛlpfʊl ədˈvaɪs, mɑːk dɪˈsaɪdɪd tuː ˈpɜːtʃəs ðə ˈprɒdʌkt ɪˈmiːdɪətli/
sentences.text_native: Rassuré par ces précieux conseils, Mark a décidé d'acheter le produit immédiatement.

sentences.text_target: The total price came to fifteen euros and fifty cents.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈtəʊtl praɪs keɪm tuː ˈfɪftiːn ˈjʊərəʊz ænd ˈfɪfti sɛnts/
sentences.text_native: Le prix total s'est élevé à quinze euros et cinquante centimes.

sentences.text_target: He took his payment card out of his pocket and tapped it on the machine.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː tʊk hɪz ˈpeɪmənt kɑːd aʊt ɒv hɪz ˈpɒkɪt ænd tæpt ɪt ɒn ðə məˈʃiːn/
sentences.text_native: Il a sorti sa carte bancaire de sa poche et l'a approchée du terminal de paiement.

sentences.text_target: The transaction was approved quickly without requiring his secret PIN code.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə trænˈzækʃən wɒz əˈpruːvd ˈkwɪkli wɪˈaʊt rɪˈkwaɪərɪŋ hɪz ˈsiːkrɪt pɪn kəʊd/
sentences.text_native: La transaction a été validée rapidement sans nécessiter la saisie de son code secret.

sentences.text_target: The polite assistant placed the medicine box into a small paper bag.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə pəˈlaɪt əˈsɪstənt pleɪst ðə ˈmɛdsɪn bɒks ˈɪntuː ə smɔːl ˈpeɪpə bæɡ/
sentences.text_native: L'assistant poli a glissé la boîte de médicaments dans un petit sac en papier.

sentences.text_target: Mark accepted the printed receipt and folded it carefully before putting it away.
sentences.phonetic: /mɑːk əkˈsɛptɪd ðə ˈprɪntɪd rɪˈsiːt ænd ˈfəʊldɪd ɪt ˈkɛəfʊli bɪˈfɔːr ˈpʊtɪŋ ɪt əˈweɪ/
sentences.text_native: Mark a pris le ticket de caisse et l'a plié soigneusement avant de le ranger.

sentences.text_target: Thanking the staff for their excellent service, he wished them a good afternoon.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈθæŋkɪŋ ðə stɑːf fɔː ðeər ˈɛksələnt ˈsɜːvɪs, hiː wɪʃt ðɛm ə ɡʊd ˈɑːftənuːn/
sentences.text_native: Remerciant le personnel pour leur excellent service, il leur a souhaité un bon après-midi.

sentences.text_target: Stepping back outside into the bustling street, he felt a sudden sense of relief.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈstɛpɪŋ bæk ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ˈɪntuː ðə ˈbʌslɪŋ striːt, hiː fɛlt ə ˈsʌdn sɛns ɒv rɪˈliːf/
sentences.text_native: En ressortant dans la rue animée, il a ressenti un soudain sentiment de soulagement.

sentences.text_target: He knew that improving his health would require a gradual change in his daily habits.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː nuː ðæt ɪmˈpruːvɪŋ hɪz hɛlθ wʊd rɪˈkwaɪə ə ˈɡrædjʊəl tʃeɪndʒ ɪn hɪz ˈdeɪli ˈhæbɪts/
sentences.text_native: Il savait que l'amélioration de sa santé nécessiterait un changement progressif de ses habitudes quotidiennes.

sentences.text_target: Returning home that evening, he drank a large glass of water and prepared a balanced meal.
sentences.phonetic: /rɪˈtɜːnɪŋ həʊm ðæt ˈiːvnɪŋ, hiː dræŋk ə lɑːʤ ɡlɑːs ɒv ˈwɔːtər ænd prɪˈpeəd ə ˈbælənst miːl/
sentences.text_native: De retour chez lui ce soir-là, il a bu un grand verre d'eau et a préparé un repas équilibré.

sentences.text_target: He placed the magnesium tablets on his kitchen counter so he would not forget them.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː pleɪst ðə mæɡˈniːziəm ˈtæblɪts ɒn hɪz ˈkɪtʃɪn ˈkaʊntə səʊ hiː wʊd nɒt fəˈɡɛt ðɛm/
sentences.text_native: Il a posé les comprimés de magnésium sur le plan de travail de sa cuisine pour ne pas les oublier.

sentences.text_target: By committing to a better sleep routine, he hoped his recovery would start very soon.
sentences.phonetic: /baɪ kəˈmɪtɪŋ tuː ə ˈbɛtə sliːp ruːˈtiːn, hiː həʊpt hɪz rɪˈkʌvəri wʊd stɑːt ˈvɛri suːn/
sentences.text_native: En s'engageant à adopter une meilleure routine de sommeil, il espérait que sa récupération commencerait très bientôt.

sentences.text_target: Goodbye to constant exhaustion, he thought, as he turned off the lights for the night.
sentences.phonetic: /ɡʊdˈbaɪ tuː ˈkɒnstənt ɪɡˈzɔːstʃən, hiː θɔːt, æz hiː tɜːnd ɒf ðə laɪts fɔː ðə naɪt/
sentences.text_native: Adieu la fatigue constante, pensa-t-il en éteignant les lumières pour la nuit.
